name: othername-msupn-constraint-no-upn-san-valid
description: An intermediate CA carries a permittedSubtrees otherName constraint for the Microsoft User Principal Name form (OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.311.20.2.3), commonly used in Active Directory smart-card login certificates. The leaf carries only a DNS SAN and no UPN otherName. Per RFC 5280 4.2.1.10, a leaf containing no name of the constrained type is acceptable for that type — the UPN permit has nothing to apply to and must not cause rejection.
references: GnuTLS NEWS 3.7.5 — UPN otherName NC parsing failure
notes: GnuTLS <3.7.5 failed to parse NameConstraints carrying a UPN otherName, causing rejection or import errors even for chains where the leaf had no UPN name at all. The UPN payload is a UTF8String wrapped in the OtherName value (i.e. the OtherName.value field). The cryptography library accepts the encoded inner UTF8String via the utf8 shortcut.
